visual_identity.core_identity: An enormous bat with a broad membrane wingspan, powerful clawed feet, and an unmistakable natural bat silhouette.
visual_identity.silhouette: Wide folded or partly opened wings, hanging inverted body, large pointed ears, narrow torso, clawed feet capable of gripping overhead support.
visual_identity.head_features: Natural bat face with large ears, short muzzle, small eyes, no monstrous humanoid features.
visual_identity.body_shape: Natural bat body: the two forelimbs ARE the two membrane wings, each supported by elongated finger bones; compact torso and two hind legs/feet only. There is no separate pair of arms.
visual_identity.surface: Short fur on body and smooth wing membranes with minimal vein lines.
must_avoid: separate arms in addition to wings
tail longer than a natural bat membrane tail

accuracy_checks: environment remains secondary to the bat
exactly two forelimbs and they are the wings; no separate arms exist
hind feet grip the overhead support while the head hangs below

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: overhead_attachment: inverted roosting posture requires a believable overhead support; environment engine chooses the ceiling, rock, beam, branch, or other compatible support
description: An enormous bat with a broad membrane wingspan, powerful clawed feet, and an unmistakable natural bat silhouette. Light flying mammal body with very long finger-boned wings and compact torso. Short fur on body and smooth wing membranes with minimal vein lines.
